commitResults.messageTitle: Fix search boundaries and index consistency
commitResults.messageBody:
Slash markers in supported names can silently become search filters,
while pasted horizontal spaces and Unicode index digits behave
differently across commands.

Reject slash-containing search values before changing either result
panel, normalize horizontal spaces for text matching, and align
membership indices with the shared index parser. Give unknown prefixes
precedence over blank values and show readable category names.

Add parser, matching and command regressions for these boundaries and
verify that failed searches preserve both views and stored data.
